title: Next State After a Simulated Step
statement: For a finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet, a bit vector encoding a selector, an input-head position, a configuration of $M$, two auxiliary tapes and their head positions, and an output-register value $r$, the next simulating state determined by a proposed successor state $q'$ and boundary tag $b$ is the return state carrying the bit vector, $q'$, $r$, and $b$ when $q'$ exists; if $q'$ is absent, it is the waiting-decision state carrying the bit vector, no state, $r$, and $b$.
hypotheses_covered: A bit vector indexed by the selector-bit count of $M$
An input-head position on the Boolean input $y$
Auxiliary tapes $	au_C,	au_O$ and head positions $z_C,z_O$
A proposed successor state $q'$ or no state
